head_height.value: 32-36 mm (chin to crown) with sufficient headroom

file_spec.value: JPEG, max 5 MB, min 1200 x 1600 pixels (W x H) for digital camera; 600 DPI for scanner at 40x50mm

clothing_restriction.value: Avoid overly dark or overly light-coloured clothing; avoid heavy make-up

expression_restriction.value: Full frontal face with clear facial features

glasses_policy.value: Frames must not cross the eyes; flash reflections on glasses are unacceptable

face_visibility.value: Full frontal face with clear facial features; hair must not cover eyes or eyebrows

size.evidence: Official IMMD page (https://www.immd.gov.hk/eng/residents/immigration/traveldoc/photorequirements.html) applies the same 40mm x 50mm photo requirements to both HKSAR Passports and Documents of Identity for Visa Purposes. Multiple independent photo service sites (visafoto.com/hk-visa-photo, idphotodiy.com) confirm Hong Kong visa photos are 40x50mm. This matches the claimed 4.0 x 5.0 cm (40 x 50 mm).
